Definition: of Chaldee origin (by parody on H1176); dung-god; Beelzebul, a name of Satan:--Beelzebub.
BiblicalUsage: The name Beelzebul appears in the New Testament. It turns up in Matthew 10:25, Matthew 12:24 and Matthew 12:27.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Beelzebul is in Scripture for a reason, and no name there is an accident.
